If you want, I can assist you with other options such as checking if there are any available flights with insurance included or any other support you may need. Please let me know how you would like to proceed.

I really need to have insurance for this trip, just like my family. Is there any way to make an exception or escalate this? I’d really appreciate it if you could look into this further or see if there’s any possible solution. I don’t want to be the only one traveling without coverage.
